ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportAdresy' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportAdresy;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportAdresy] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
select distinct KntGidNumer,KntLp,KntKraj into #customerIds from cdn.POS_KntDoeksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0)
declare @LastMod bigint = isnull((select max(Frm_CzasModyfikacji) from cdn.PicoStanowiska join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = PcK_PicoID join cdn.FrmStruktura on FRS_ID = PcK_CentrumID join cdn.Firma on Frm_GidNumer = FRS_FrmNumer where PSa_ID = @PointOfSaleId),@rowVersion)
declare @LastMod2 bigint = isnull((select max(KnA_LastModL) FROM #customerIds JOIN CDN.KntAdresy ON KnA_KntNumer = KntGidNumer),@rowVersion)
declare @LastMod3 bigint = isnull((select max(KnS_CzasModyfikacji) FROM #customerIds JOIN CDN.KntOsoby ON KnS_KntNumer = KntGidNumer where KnS_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion),@rowVersion)
select @LastMod = case when @LastMod > @LastMod2 then @LastMod else @LastMod2 end select @LastMod = case when @LastMod3 > @LastMod then @LastMod3 else @LastMod end
declare @AdresyFirma table(ObjGuid nvarchar(41),ObjectTypeId int,ObjectId int,AddressTypeId int,IsDefault varchar(5), Data XML) declare @AdresyKontrahenci table(ObjGuid nvarchar(41),ObjectTypeId int,ObjectGUID nvarchar(41),AddressTypeId int,IsDefault varchar(5), Data XML) declare @AdresyOsobyKontaktowe table(ObjGuid nvarchar(41),ObjectTypeId int,ObjectGUID nvarchar(41),AddressTypeId int,IsDefault varchar(5), Data XML)
insert into @AdresyFirma select * from ( select Frm_GUID as [@GUID], 5 as [@ObjectTypeId], --pieczątka 0 as [@ObjectId], 0 as [@Type], --general address 'true' as [@IsDefault], ( select distinct Frm_GUIDdane as [@GUID], RTRIM(Frm_Ulica) as [@Street], '' as [@BuildingNumber], --Nie ma u nas takiego pola --as [@ApartmentNumber] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola RTRIM(case when frm_kodp='00-000' then '' else frm_kodp end) as [@ZipCode], RTRIM(frm_miasto) as [@City], --as [@ProvinceId] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola. TRZEBA DODAĆ KPC_Id as [@CountryId], RTRIM(frm_Powiat) as [@County], RTRIM(frm_Gmina) as [@Commune], --as [@PostOffice] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola DATEADD(second,Frm_CzasModyfikacji,convert(datetime,'01-01-1990',105)) as [@ModificationDate] , 'true' as [@IsActive], --as [@AdditionalData] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola --as [@AdditionalData2] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola RTRIM(RTRIM(Frm_Nazwa1)+' '+RTRIM(Frm_Nazwa2)+' '+RTRIM(Frm_Nazwa3)+' '+RTRIM(Frm_Nazwa4)) as [@LocalName], RTRIM(Frm_Opis) as [@Description] for xml path('Data'), type ) Address from cdn.PicoStanowiska join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = PcK_PicoID join cdn.FrmStruktura on FRS_ID = PcK_CentrumID join cdn.Firma on Frm_GidNumer = FRS_FrmNumer join cdn.KrajeCelne on Frm_Kraj = KPC_Kod where PSa_ID = @PointOfSaleId --and (Frm_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion OR @rowVersion=0) ) as aa
insert into @AdresyKontrahenci select * from( SELECT Kna_GUID as [@GUID], 1 as [@ObjectTypeId], --Adres dostawy KNT_GUID as [@ObjectGUID], 0 as [@Type], --general address case when Knt_KnANumer=KnA_GIDNumer then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsDefault], ( select distinct kna_GUIDdane as [@GUID], RTRIM(max(KnA_Ulica)) as [@Street], '' as [@BuildingNumber], --Nie ma u nas takiego pola --as [@ApartmentNumber] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola RTRIM(case when max(KnA_KodP) in ('00-000','00000') then '' else max(KnA_KodP) end) as [@ZipCode], RTRIM(max(KnA_Miasto)) as [@City], --as [@ProvinceId] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola. TRZEBA DODAĆ max(KpC_Id) as [@CountryId], RTRIM(max(KnA_Powiat)) as [@County], RTRIM(max(KnA_Gmina)) as [@Commune], --as [@PostOffice] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola DATEADD(second,max(KnA_LastModL),convert(datetime,'01-01-1990',105)) as [@ModificationDate] , case when KnA_DataArc <> 0 then 'false' else 'true' end as [@IsActive], --as [@AdditionalData] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola --as [@AdditionalData2] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola RTRIM(RTRIM(max(KnA_Nazwa1))+' '+RTRIM(max(KnA_Nazwa2))+' '+RTRIM(max(KnA_Nazwa3))) as [@LocalName], RTRIM(max(KnA_Opis)) as [@Description] for xml path('Data'), type ) Address FROM #customerIds JOIN cdn.KntKarty on Knt_GIDNumer = KntGidNumer JOIN CDN.KntAdresy ON KnA_KntNumer = Knt_GIDNumer join cdn.KrajeCelne on KnA_Kraj = KPC_Kod where ((SELECT MAX(rw) FROM (VALUES (KnA_LastModL),(Knt_LastModL)) AS rws(rw)) > @rowVersion OR @rowVersion=0) GROUP BY KNA_GUID,KnA_GIDNumer,Knt_GIDNumer,KNT_GUID,kna_guiddane,Knt_KnANumer,KnA_DataArc )as aa
insert into @AdresyOsobyKontaktowe select * from( select kns_GUID as [@GUID], 10 as [@ObjectTypeId], --osoba kontaktowa kns_GUID as [@ObjectGUID], 0 as [@Type], --general address 'true' as [@IsDefault], ( select distinct kns_GUID as [@GUID], --Nie ma u nas takiego pola. TRZEBA DODAĆ '' as [@Street], '' as [@BuildingNumber], --Nie ma u nas takiego pola --as [@ApartmentNumber] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola '' as [@ZipCode], '' as [@City], --as [@ProvinceId] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola. TRZEBA DODAĆ max(KpC_Id) as [@CountryId], '' as [@County], '' as [@Commune], --as [@PostOffice] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola DATEADD(second,max(KnS_CzasModyfikacji),convert(datetime,'01-01-1990',105)) as [@ModificationDate] , case when KnS_Archiwalny <> 0 then 'false' else 'true' end as [@IsActive], --as [@AdditionalData] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola --as [@AdditionalData2] --Nie ma u nas takiego pola RTRIM(KnS_Nazwa) as [@LocalName], '' as [@Description] for xml path('Data'), type ) Address FROM #customerIds JOIN CDN.KntOsoby ON KnS_KntNumer = KntGidNumer join cdn.KrajeCelne on KntKraj = KPC_Kod where KnS_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion GROUP BY kns_GUID,KnS_Archiwalny,KnS_Nazwa )as ba SELECT @LastMod AS [@RowVersion] ,( select ObjGuid as[@GUID], ObjectTypeId as [@ObjectTypeId],ObjectId as [@ObjectId],AddressTypeId as [@Type], IsDefault as [@IsDefault],Data from @AdresyFirma for xml path('Address'), type ) ,( select ObjGuid as[@GUID], ObjectTypeId as [@ObjectTypeId],ObjectGUID as [@ObjectGUID],AddressTypeId as [@Type], IsDefault as [@IsDefault],Data from @AdresyKontrahenci for xml path('Address'), type ) ,( select ObjGuid as[@GUID], ObjectTypeId as [@ObjectTypeId],ObjectGUID as [@ObjectGUID],AddressTypeId as [@Type], IsDefault as [@IsDefault],Data from @AdresyOsobyKontaktowe for xml path('Address'), type ) for xml path('Addresses')
SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportAdresy TO CDNRaport
